description: Join multiple video clips into one file, right in your browser. Clips play in order and are re-recorded into a single downloadable video.

faqs.a: Each clip is drawn onto a canvas frame-by-frame while its audio is routed through Web Audio, and one continuous MediaRecorder recording captures the whole sequence.
Output size follows your first clip; other clips are letterboxed to fit. The output is WebM (MP4 on Safari) at a high bitrate.
faqs.q: What resolution is the merged video?

faqs.a: Yes — everything is processed locally on your device. No clip is ever uploaded.

howto: Add two or more video files — they merge in the order shown.
Reorder clips with the up/down arrows or remove ones you do not want.
Click "Merge Videos" and wait while each clip is re-recorded in sequence.
Download the single merged video file when it is ready.
title: Video Merger
